visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight dark hair and bangs, wearing a blue halter top and a white ruffled skirt, stands on a paved sidewalk at night. The background features city streetlights and store signs. She smiles broadly and gestures with her hands while looking directly at the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a digital phone interface overlay. A video plays showing the same woman using a white, uniquely shaped tool to massage her head, neck, and shoulders. Yellow checkmarks and text labels appear next to the treated areas. (3) The woman is shown in various outfits, including a khaki fitness set and a white t-shirt. A comparison is made between her pregnant body and her current slimmed-down state, focusing specifically on her legs which are shown in a close-up top-down view on a wooden floor. (4) The setting shifts to an indoor room with light-colored curtains. The woman holds up a white, bone-shaped massage tool with the brand name 'DR. GRANDMA' printed on it. She then presents two bottles of leg massage lotion, one with a white label and one with a blue label. (5) In a close-up shot, the woman applies lotion to her thigh and uses the deep-serrated edge of the white tool to scrape the skin. An anatomical diagram of the leg with labeled acupoints is overlaid on the screen to illustrate the massage technique. (6) She continues the demonstration on her calf, using the same tool and a different lotion bottle with a blue label. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture of the skin and the product. (7) The video concludes with a split-screen shot of her legs, showing a 'before and after' effect of the massage. Finally, the woman is seen outdoors in a park and then back indoors holding the complete set of products, smiling and giving a thumbs up.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female voice speaking in a friendly, conversational tone. An upbeat, medium-tempo BGM featuring piano and a light drum beat plays in the background. The acoustic environment has a subtle outdoor urban hum. (2) A sharp 'Pop' sound effect triggers a transition. The vocal delivery becomes more descriptive and instructional. (3) As the speaker mentions 'Dr. Grandma', a metallic 'Ding' SFX is heard, coinciding with product highlights. The BGM remains consistent in volume, serving as a bright, optimistic bedding. (4) Several consecutive UI sound effects (blips) occur as the speaker lists different massage points. The speech rate is fast but clear, indicating enthusiasm. (5) The track concludes with the woman summarizing her experience with high vocal valence and a final rhythmic swell in the BGM before fading out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Personal Story -> Product Introduction -> Technical Demonstration -> Before/After Result -> Recommendation.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a specific leg massage tool and accompanying lotions from the brand 'Dr. Grandma' by showcasing a successful postpartum weight loss and body shaping journey. It uses a combination of personal testimonials and clear instructional demonstrations to build trust and demonstrate product efficacy.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of products, brand name mention, demonstration of usage, and positive results testimonial.
